stem: Arrange the following 2025 events in correct chronological order: 1. SpaDeX docking demonstration 2. Pahalgam terror attack 3. INS Surat / INS Nilgiri / INS Vagsheer triple commissioning 4. Operation Sindoor 5. COP30 at Belém
solution: SpaDeX (16 Jan 2025) → Triple commissioning (15 Jan 2025, before SpaDeX) → wait, re-checking dates: Triple commissioning was 15 Jan 2025, SpaDeX docking demo completed 16 Jan 2025 — so triple comm was 1 day earlier.
